Name: Lily your farmmate
Author: iamkazu
Description:
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the latest version of the supporting mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=files]SMAPI[/url](required).[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2. Download and extract LilyYourFarmmate.zip[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Copy the entire newly extracted localization folder into the "Mods" folder within your game installation directory—for example, "C:\Program Files\Stardew Valley\Mods" or "Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods".[/color]

Language: Tiếng việt, English, Chinese (translated).

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lily can perform five independently enabled tasks.[/color]
[code]Farm care
├── Crop care
│   ├── Water crops
│   ├── Harvest crops
│   └── Plant seeds
└── Animal care
    ├── Pet animals
    └── Collect animal products[/code][color=#D4D4D8][b]The Lily work priority differs from the menu order: [/b][/color]
Harvest ripe crops > Plant available seeds > Water dry crops > Pet animals > Collect animal products.
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Stamina and recovery stamina[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lily's maximum energy depends on her friendship hearts and the [b]player's current maximum stamina[/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8]:[/color]
[table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Hearts with Lily[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Lily's maximum energy[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]0[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]25% of player maximum stamina[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]1[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]35%[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]2[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]45%[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]3[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]55%[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]4[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]65%[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]5[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]75%[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]6[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]85%[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]7 or more[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]100%[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][color=#D4D4D8]When Lily needs to recover energy, she returns to a suitable place in the farmhouse and rests. Eligible resting periods restore [b]10% of Lily's own maximum energy every 10 in-game minutes[/b], with fractional amounts carried over to later recovery intervals. When resting because of insufficient energy for work, she resumes after reaching at least [b]50%[/b] of her maximum energy. At the beginning of a new day, her energy is restored to the full current maximum.
Recovery from resting and the start-of-day refill are separate from changes to the maximum-energy cap.[/color]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]4. Lily's backpack[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lily has a persistent inventory independent of the player's backpack. Open it through [b]Interact → Open backpack[/b].[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Capacity:[/b] Matches the player's currently unlocked inventory size (normally [b]12, 24, or 36 slots[/b]). The capacity updates when the player's backpack is upgraded without clearing Lily's stored items.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Transfers:[/b] Supported items can be moved between the player's inventory and Lily's backpack, including stackable seeds and ordinary farm products.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Storage restrictions:[/b] Only ordinary Stardew Valley Object items are supported. Tools, furniture, machines with internal state, and other specialized items are not accepted.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Persistence:[/b] Saved items retain their slots, stack sizes, quality, and supported item metadata between sessions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Harvest safety:[/b] Crop and animal-product collection will not discard items when storage is insufficient; unsupported or non-fitting results are left in the world.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Lily uses seeds [b]from this backpack[/b] for planting, and stores collected crops and animal products [b]in this backpack[/b]. Gifts given directly to Lily are a separate friendship interaction and are not deposited here.[/color]

[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]5. Lily's daily routine[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]The following times describe the default schedule. The work start/end times can be configured, but the evening home routine begins no later than [b]17:00[/b].[/color]
[table][tr][th]In-game time[/th]
[th]Lily's routine[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]06:00–07:59[/b][/td]
[td]Prepares indoors;[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]08:00–11:59[/b][/td]
[td]Morning shift: performs enabled and unlocked jobs. If exhausted, returns home to rest.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]12:00–12:59[/b][/td]
[td]Lunch break: does not work; free roaming restores 3% per 10 minutes. If already exhausted and resting, she can continue the 10% resting recovery.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]13:00–16:59[/b][/td]
[td]Afternoon shift: continue the list of unfinished tasks.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]17:00–05:59[/b][/td]
[td]Stops working and returns to the farmhouse, then wanders indoors. Idle recovery restores 3% per 10 minutes.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]New day[/b][/td]
[td]Starts indoors and receives one full energy refill for the genuinely new day. QuickSave/load on the same day does not trigger a refill.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[b]NEXT UPDATE LOG:
[/b]- Add the storyline and add event hearts.
- expand the schedule of activities

Thank you to everyone who has downloaded and supported the mod; every download motivates me to continue developing more features.
